units.title: What is a bookable unit?
units.copy: A bookable unit is something with its own availability, such as a room, dorm bed or rental. For group lessons and tours, a unit is usually a place for one person, not the full activity. A private lesson or tour can also be a unit when it is booked as a whole. Packages can combine multiple units without creating duplicate inventory.

faq.question: Does Hightide charge commission on bookings?
faq.answer: No. Hightide does not charge commission on bookings made through your Online Store. Standard fees from your chosen payment provider still apply.

faq.question: Is guided setup included?
faq.answer: Yes. We begin by learning how your business works and help prepare the initial Hightide structure around your accommodation, activities and packages.

faq.question: Can I start with a free trial?
faq.answer: Yes. You can explore Hightide free for 30 days without entering a credit card. For businesses with more complex booking structures, we recommend starting with a discovery call.

faq.question: What counts as a bookable unit?
faq.answer: A bookable unit is something with its own availability, such as a room, dorm bed or rental. For group lessons and tours, a unit is usually a place for one person, not the full activity. A private lesson or tour can also be a unit when it is booked as a whole.

faq.question: Can I change plans later?
faq.answer: Yes. You can change plans or add more capacity as your operation grows.

faq.question: Is the channel manager included?
faq.answer: The channel manager is an optional add-on for accommodation businesses that need to connect inventory with external booking channels.

faq.question: Does Hightide support both accommodation and activities?
faq.answer: Yes. Bringing accommodation, activities and packages together is one of Hightide’s biggest strengths. You can manage them in one system, with connected availability whether they are booked separately or as part of a package.

vatNote: All prices are exclusive of VAT. VAT may be added at checkout depending on your country and business status.
